requirement.title: Add a beneficiary and allow an authenticated customer to transfer money to the beneficiary after authentication
requirement.description: As an authenticated customer, I want to add a beneficiary and then transfer money to that beneficiary so that I can send funds to people and organisations I trust. Adding a beneficiary and initiating a transfer both require the customer to be authenticated; adding a beneficiary additionally requires a successful step-up authentication challenge. All beneficiary and transfer input is validated, and a customer may only view and transfer to beneficiaries they own.

acceptanceCriteria.text: An authenticated customer can add a new beneficiary with valid details, and the beneficiary is persisted to that customer's beneficiary list.
Adding a beneficiary requires a successful step-up authentication challenge (synthetic one-time code); if the challenge fails, the beneficiary is not added.
Beneficiary input (display name, account identifier, currency) is validated before persistence; invalid or incomplete input is rejected with an error.
A customer can only view, edit, and transfer to beneficiaries they own; attempts to access another customer's beneficiary are denied.
An authenticated customer can transfer money to an existing beneficiary they own; a successful transfer records a debit against the customer and a corresponding transfer record.
A transfer is rejected if the customer's session is missing, expired, or authentication otherwise fails; no funds move in that case.
A transfer amount must be a positive value, must not exceed the configured per-transaction limit, and must not exceed the customer's available balance; otherwise the transfer is rejected.
Sensitive values (credentials, step-up one-time codes, and full account identifiers) are never returned in API responses and never written to application logs.

perTransactionLimit.note: Synthetic illustrative value only. XTS is the ISO 4217 code reserved for testing. Not a real limit or policy.
